channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: The network documentation was expanded with a roadmap and requirement list for the upcoming version, and the backup system was updated to support a tiered archive and light node model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: An outdated AI submodule was removed from the system, and the network’s backup and cold‑storage handling were updated to improve data retention and logging. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: Investor tools added new lockout scenario calculations and improved value formatting, while the SDK introduced a payout address function and refined its runner configuration. Additional updates improved third‑party storage handling and added a numeric keypad component to the client scaffold. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusWallet, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: The network milestone audit was completed and related documentation recorded, and new payout address getters were added to network accounts. The SDK added support for idempotency keys, and the wallet now reports a real count of processed jobs. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusWallet, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: The SDK introduced service registration, rotating refresh tokens, and password hashing for better security, with documentation added. The network build process was adjusted to use self‑hosted runners, and the investor dashboard received design and accessibility improvements. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 9 November
item.description: The SDK fixed password handling to hash passwords and added tests to verify the changes. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding.
